changes.text: Catalysed set pieces keep the stats of the item they were made from, in sims and tooltips, including after an Armory import.
A catalysed set piece shows a small icon of its original item (character gear, Top Gear, best gear); hover it for that item's tooltip.
"What's new" after an update: this window. You can turn it off below or in Settings → Updates.
New Stat Targets tab: the best split of your gear's secondary stats, simmed at full gear (every item at the top upgrade step).
New Trinkets tab: ranks the season's trinkets at chosen item levels.
New Advanced tab: run a hand-edited simc input as a Quick Sim.
Import a character from the Armory, no setup needed. Your own Blizzard API client is an optional fallback in Settings.
Top Gear: add items by name, in the game language or English; lock an equipped ring, trinket or one-hander in its slot; Great Vault items right under the equipped one.
Top Gear results: a best-gear summary that frames only what changed, and an Auctionator shopping list for the winner in the game language.
Droptimizer: shows which worn item each drop replaces and catalysed drops as their set piece; item-level chips, Raid + Mythic+, bonus roll.
Character panel: gear grid with item levels, stats panel with a Rating / % switch, Armory portraits framed for every playable race.
Item tooltips count your worn set pieces (2/5 instead of 0/5) and highlight the set bonuses you have.
Raid buffs: grouped tiles with tooltips; your own Bloodlust can be turned off.
Top bar: smaller sims are in the "More" menu.
Number fields: clear and retype freely; the allowed range applies on Enter or when you leave the field.
Fixed: the bonus roll on dungeon loot is +10 at Myth 1/6.
